I am a Ph.D. student at UC Berkeley interested in research at the intersection of machine learning, signal processing, and information theory. I graduated from Cornell University in May 2025 with a B.S. in Electrical & Computer Engineering. My research is supported by an NSF Graduate Research Fellowship and the Berkeley Fellowship.
